label: Physical Alpha signed interval lowering after
methodology: Warm in-process calls timed by the site matrix harnesses; median per call after symmetric 1.5×IQR outlier filtering, raw samples and exclusions retained. Every timed checksum and the printed output are verified against the instruction engine. Native samples execute 32 checked calls in one ELF process and divide by 32, amortizing one process startup per sample; other targets exclude process startup. Compilation is excluded.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained

native.host_observation_scope: Untimed Linux sysfs snapshots for all logical CPUs, not the clock frequency of the child process; an unpinned process can migrate. Missing readings are null. Observations do not filter timing samples or change affinity or governor.
